{{Quote|Pardon me, sir, but why should we take orders from a youngling?|Troy upon first meeting Bant Eerin's Padawan|<ref name="TWotJ" />}}
'''Troy''' was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] serving in the [[Eighteenth Battalion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. An outspoken trooper, Troy questioned the sense of following [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin's]] [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|new padawan]] whom he referred to as a "[[Youngling/Legends|youngling]]." Although Troy quickly silenced himself after being chastised by his [[Herc|CO]], he later continued to spout derogatory comments toward the padawan and the padawan's plan. But by the end of the [[Battle of Akoshissss]], Troy had come to respect his commander, shaking hands and claiming it had been an honor.<ref name="TWotJ" />

==Equipment==
Troy wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] that was marked with [[Color/Legends|red]] swatches and had red shoulder armor.<ref name="TWotJ" />
